about: The game's 3D models (docs/assets/MODELS.md). Each model starts as a Gemini concept picture (its prompt, its style line and the framing line), becomes a 3D model with Meshy, and is prepared for phones by scripts/art/models.ts into public/assets/models/. 'size' is the real size in metres along the longest side, 'triangles' the budget, 'texture' the largest texture side in pixels, 'turn' the degrees about +Y that make the model face +Z (found by looking at the previews). Optional: 'views' (extra views of the same object drawn by Gemini from the concept, so Meshy builds from several pictures), 'keep' (a box in Meshy's own axes; what lies outside is cut away), 'source' (a Meshy model made before this list, from the style test, remeshed to the budget). 'record' is written by the script (D-28): the concept's prompt and SHA-256, the Meshy task, settings, credits and dates, and every discarded attempt with why. Concepts are the owner's to use under Google's terms; Meshy models are made on the owner's paid plan, which leaves them the owner's.

No legs, no wings, no propellers, no mouth.
